propertyFacts.value: N = [Γ S_h/(π r²)] × [S_h/(S_h + α S_s)], with S_h = π R², S_s = 2πRt, and Γ = π/(2√3).

propertyFacts.label: Model assumptions
propertyFacts.value: Ideal two-dimensional hexagonal close packing; random deposition on substrate and an α fraction of sidewall area; only substrate QDs remain; interparticle interactions neglected.
propertyFacts.scope: Hexagonal close packing here is planar sphere packing, not crystallographic phase.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
